title: No key typed right after Cmd-N, Cmd-T from a terminal or Cmd-D from a New Tab page is lost: the new New Tab page's field holds the whole text
preconditions: a fresh launch: one window, one terminal workspace (the script's cold run: the app's first Cmd-N)
converted from scripts/cmux-next/new-workspace-real-typing-e2e.py (cx-kql5h), which stays for its real-event and timing legs; tests/oracle/corpus/e2e/_scripts-094.json links them

steps.note: Cmd-N then 'hello world 123' back to back: the keys come while the daemon makes the workspace and its page (Lawrence's 'lo world 123'), so the window holds them for the new page's field
the script's warm Cmd-T run starts on a terminal tab, made here by New Terminal Tab and not measured
Cmd-T from a terminal then the text: a new page really opens, and its field gets every key
Cmd-D from a New Tab page: the new pane gets its own New Tab page, and the keys go to its field

invariants: at after-cmd-n, after-cmd-t and after-cmd-d the focused tab is the New Tab page the step opened and its draft is sha256 of 'hello world 123'; the page the previous step typed into keeps its own draft
focus.context.terminal is false at each of those snapshots: no held key leaked to a terminal
every mutation has one receipt or one typed error (I1)
ids stay stable unless the step created or closed them (I2)
teardown: quit the tagged app the run started
verify its debug socket is gone
untested: keys posted at the window server (CGEvent, HID tap) at 25-30 keys/s with the first one 40 ms after Cmd-N: the case types through debug.key, the app's own key path, one request per key; the real-event timing stays in the script and the new-workspace-typing perf story
New Tab Page from the command palette: typing the palette query and Return would put the case's own keys into the palette's field first
cold runs after a relaunch (the script relaunches before each Cmd-N): the case's fresh launch is its one cold run
